notes: Inference-only manufactured ASIC; accuracies (results 0-2) are measured on silicon and equal the TMU software models. Training hyper-parameters (T, s, epochs, weight clipping range) are not stated; n_states/state_bits are not applicable to the inference chip (the 8-bit TA in Sec. VI-B is only an assumption for a possible training extension) and are left not_reported. Position encoding: 18-bit thermometer for each of x and y (Table I), 19x19 = 361 patches. 88% of TA actions in the MNIST model are exclude (Sec. VI-A). Results 16-17 and 39-41 are authors' estimates (28 nm scaling, envisaged CIFAR-10 TM Composites design), not measurements. Baseline rows 18-38 are quoted from other papers in Tables IV and VI; their settings are not described here. Table VI also lists IMBUE KWS-6 87.1%/5.91 nJ, IMPACT [36] 96.3%, Wheeldon [11] Binary IRIS 97.0% and Tunheim [28] 2D noisy XOR 99.9%, which the record omits. The paper cites an OpenML URL for Fashion-MNIST (ref. [15]), not the zalandoresearch GitHub URL in the record. Clock gating cut power ~60% at 27.8 MHz; CSRF alone <1% (Sec. V, p. 9).
